tips.tip: Start with a question or surprising fact
tips.description: Capture attention in the first 3 seconds with something that piques curiosity.
tips.example: Did you know that 90% of viral videos start with a question?

tips.description: Structure your content with a beginning (setup), middle (conflict), and end (resolution) to keep viewers engaged.
tips.example: Show a problem, build tension, then provide a satisfying solution.

tips.tip: Use high-contrast colors and dynamic movements
tips.description: Bright, contrasting visuals and quick cuts help in grabbing attention on fast-scrolling platforms.
tips.example: Incorporate text overlays, emojis, and fast-paced edits.

tips.description: Use 3-5 relevant hashtags, including one trending and others specific to your content.
Short-form content performs better; aim for 15-30 seconds for maximum engagement.
tips.example: TikTok videos under 30 seconds get 50% more views.

tips.description: Leverage popular sounds to increase discoverability.
tips.example: Check TikTok's trending sounds and incorporate them.

tips.description: Encourage viewers to like, comment, share, or follow.
tips.example: Like if you agree! Comment your thoughts below.

tips.description: Content that makes people laugh, cry, or feel inspired spreads faster.
tips.example: Humor, surprise, or relatability drives shares.

tips.description: Post when your audience is most active, typically evenings or weekends.
tips.example: For global audience, post between 6-9 PM local time.

tips.description: Partner with creators in your niche to reach new audiences.
tips.example: Duets or shoutouts can boost visibility.
